subject: Film & Cinema
title: Bong Joon-ho: Genre Smasher
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Bong Joon-ho: Genre Smasher.

hook.text: Parasite shifts from comedy to thriller to horror within a single scene. Only Bong can do that.

buildup.text: Every Bong film tackles class inequality through a different genre disguise.

discovery.text: His ability to mix tones without whiplash makes him one of cinema's rarest talents.

twist.text: He called the Oscars a 'very local' award — then won four of them in one night.

climax.text: Bong's success opened Hollywood's door for non-English-language films globally.

punchline.text: He smashed genres and language barriers at once.

quiz.question: What recurring theme runs through Bong Joon-ho's films?
options: Class inequality explored through different genres
